name: ugc-pilot
description: Create UGC media, finish videos, edit drafts, manage groups and saved Library outputs, and remix application references through UGC Pilot where enabled.

interface.shortDescription: Images and videos in your AI
interface.longDescription: Create media and speech using UGC Pilot where enabled. Upload local clips/audio from a supported IDE, attach demos and retrieve finished videos. Open, save and export Edit drafts. Browse application references, Creative Asset groups and saved Carousel/slideshow Library outputs; remix text and change groups/Library when their gates permit. Read and edit shared Business Context drafts and apply reviewed changes for future content with separate brand consent where enabled. Resume business onboarding with saved answers and durable analysis/completion where the separate brand write gate permits. Slideshow text rendering, voice cloning and social publishing remain unavailable through MCP. Private beta; updating this package does not activate server features.
capabilities: Demo library and upload recovery where deployed
Saved Edit drafts and export where enabled
Speech, private audio transfer and editing attachments where enabled
Application reference catalogue and saved text remix where enabled
Creative Asset groups and membership where enabled
Saved Carousel/slideshow Library management where enabled
Account publishing defaults and timezone initialization with separate consent where enabled
Shared Business Context drafts and reviewed promotion with separate consent where enabled
Saved website/manual/mobile business onboarding with durable receipts where enabled
defaultPrompt: Check my UGC Pilot connection, plan, credits, and generation options without generating anything.
Use UGC Pilot to create one vertical product image.
Use UGC Pilot to animate an image from my library into a five-second vertical video.

positive.description: Check the connected account without spending credits
positive.prompt: Check my UGC Pilot connection, plan, credits, and generation options. Do not generate anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the actual account, plan, available balance and supported options. Does not initialize an allowance, submit work or spend credits.

positive.description: Generate one image and retrieve its actual output
positive.prompt: Use UGC Pilot to generate one 9:16 image of a plain ceramic mug on a wooden table.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks access and cost, submits count 1 with a stable request ID, and retrieves the completed owned image. Reports a pending or failed job truthfully; does not invent a finished URL.

positive.description: Animate an explicitly selected owned image
positive.prompt: Show my UGC Pilot images and ask which image to animate. After I choose, create one five-second 9:16 video with a slow camera push-in.
positive.tools_triggered: list_assets, get_asset, get_entitlements, get_capabilities, generate_video, get_job
positive.expected_behavior: Waits for the user's reference selection, verifies ownership, checks cost, then submits duration_seconds 5 and count 1. Retrieves the real result or reports the actual job status.

positive.description: Attach a selected owned demo without generating new footage
positive.prompt: Attach my selected owned demo after my selected hook and return the finished video. Do not generate new footage.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks deployed availability and creative permission, validates selected assets, submits one stable finishing UUID, polls its receipt and retrieves the actual output. Reports disabled rollout, pending or failed work truthfully without starting generation.

positive.description: Resume an existing generation without another charge
positive.prompt: Check the UGC Pilot job we started earlier in this conversation. Do not generate again.
positive.expected_behavior: Uses the existing job ID, checks its status, and retrieves owned output assets on completion. Requests the missing job ID if there is no prior receipt. Does not submit another generation.

negative.prompt: Schedule my UGC Pilot video on all my social accounts.
Use UGC Pilot to generate exactly three five-second videos. Do not change the requested count.
Use an image belonging to someone else's UGC Pilot account without their authorization.

publication.release_notes: Adds the shared Business Context read/draft/apply/recovery workflow. Writes require deployed schema, enabled gate, fresh brand:write consent, current revisions and durable request UUIDs. Existing goals, generated media and today's pinned content are preserved. Onboarding, website reanalysis and logo/screenshot management remain separate work; package installation does not activate features.
